meta.validation: Routes, page ids, capability identifiers, bank ids and layer ids were checked against the listed source files. Feature descriptions are bounded to visible UI and connected code paths.
uncertainties: Installed model weights and local device paths vary by operator; Settings can override default model ids.
Index readiness and result quality are runtime data and are not asserted by this catalog.

product.name: Abstract-Mindfreak · AM-Core
product.purpose: Local workbench for retrieval and review of published audio-production parameters across text, audio and image/spectrogram workflows.

boundaries.parameter_authority: The published parameter library managed by Parameter Catalogue; generated corpora and retrieval indexes are not the catalogue.
boundaries.index_maintenance: Service Bay provides status and explicit manual rebuild operations for supported indexes.
boundaries.session_workbench: AM Tri-Modal Stage coordinates session media, retrieval results, banks, timeline and project outputs.

architecture: Next.js API routes and TypeScript jobs
Python sidecar and configured local model runtimes

primary_modes.role: Index status and explicit maintenance operations.

primary_modes.role: Structured catalogue search and review for vocal-production parameters.

primary_modes.role: Inspect and process candidate material, collections and runtime-atom workflows.

primary_modes.label: Combinatorial Synthesis
primary_modes.role: Propose, review and optionally publish parameter combinations.

primary_modes.label: Parameter Catalogue

model_registry.note: Default ids and enablement are code defaults; saved Settings can override them and do not prove that a model is installed.

stage_bank_roles.text.gemma.awtd: EmbeddingGemma 2 text identity/role pass; catalogue defaults are retained.
stage_bank_roles.stage2.client: Smoothing of already retrieved frames; no second retrieval.
stage_bank_roles.stage2.server: Separate server-side second vector retrieval pass.

runtime_invariants: Text banks for Qwen and EmbeddingGemma 2 remain separate.
Stage-2 client smoothing uses existing results; server Stage-2 is a distinct retrieval pass.
Opening a work mode or checking index status does not itself request an embedding/index build.
The spec.gemma.* capability is disabled by default.
